hero.title: About QualFM
hero.subtitle: Quality, compliance and value across every site we support

paragraphs.text: QualFM Ltd was established in February 2025 by Richard Seaver. With 25 years of delivery experience across telecoms, healthcare and pharmaceutical environments, QualFM was built to provide practical facilities and maintenance support with strong customer service and dependable technical execution.
Our goals are to deliver high-quality services with an emphasis on top-class customer service, quality workmanship and compliance through a dedicated team of professionals and technicians.
We work closely with customers to build a meaningful understanding of their business and align delivery with strategic goals.

items.question: What areas of Ireland does QualFM cover?
items.answer: QualFM is based in Portrane, North County Dublin, and delivers facilities management and maintenance services to sites nationwide across Ireland.

items.question: What services does QualFM provide?
items.answer: We provide integrated facilities and maintenance management, electrical planned, preventative and reactive maintenance, mechanical maintenance and water treatment, building fabric and soft services, fitout projects up to €1.5m, and independent compliance auditing.

items.question: Is QualFM certified for electrical and refrigerant work?
items.answer: Yes. QualFM is Safe Electric QC registered for electrical work and F-Gas registered for refrigerant handling.

items.question: Do you handle both planned and reactive maintenance?
items.answer: Yes. We operate a planned preventative maintenance model with reactive response support, so scheduled work keeps assets compliant while urgent issues are dealt with quickly.

items.question: How large a fitout project can QualFM deliver?
items.answer: We deliver commercial fitout projects up to €1.5m in value, managed end to end from design coordination to handover.

items.question: How do I get a quote from QualFM?
items.answer: Call us on +353 86 821 6215, email service@qualfm.ie, or use the contact form on our website and we will come back to you promptly.
